narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Every rhombus is a kite, so every kite is a rhombus.
<bookmark mark='kite'/>Here is a kite with sides six, six, nine and nine. Its sides are not all equal.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It is a kite but not a rhombus, so the rule does not run backwards.

narration: <bookmark mark='both'/>To check, test your shape against both lists of rules. It must keep every rule of each hoop.
<bookmark mark='one'/>To test an every statement, look for one shape that breaks it. One such shape is enough.
